name: ZYYX Pro
pre_gcode: M420 P20; set back fan speed 10 off 11-20 10-100%
M140 S10 T0; set 100% heater power
M140 S99 T0; set chamber heater negative hysteresis 19 degrees
M140 S102 T0; set chamber heater positive hysteresis 2 degrees
M140 S{bed_temp} T0; set chamber temperature
M104 S{temp} T0; set nozzle temperature
G130 X80 Y90 A127 B127 ; Set Stepper Vref to default value
G162 X Y F2500; home XY axes maximum
G162 X Y F200; home XY axes maximum slowly
G161 Z F1100; home Z axis minimum
G161 Z F100; home Z axis minimum slowly
M132 Z; Recall home offsets for Z
M131 A; store surface calibration point 1
G1 Z2 F1100; back up from buildplate
G1 X-47 F7000; move to 2nd probing point
M131 B; store surface calibration point 1
G1 Z2 F1100; back up from buildplate
G1 X135 Y-114 F7000; move to 2nd probing point
M131 AB; store surface calibration point 3
G1 Z2 F1100; back up from buildplate
G4 P1000; Wait a little bit longer
post_gcode: G0 Z195 F1000 ; send Z axis to bottom of machine
M104 S0 T0 ; cool down extruder
G162 X Y F3000 ; home XY maximum
